definition: without moving or giving way at all
description: A tug of war on a sunny tropical beach with palm trees and a volleyball net. A young woman in a coral bikini top and black shorts holds her end of the thick rope alone, feet dug deep into the sand, calm and smiling. On the other end several young men in swim shorts pull with all their strength, straining and grimacing, but the red marker ribbon on the rope hardly moves, and in the end the men fall back onto the sand. Friends watch from behind, one holding her head in disbelief.

taps.phrase: to take on the whole team
